\section{\texorpdfstring{\textbf{Appendix B. Evidence bundle and BR-KG atlas card}}{Appendix B. Evidence bundle and BR-KG atlas card}}\label{appendix-b.-evidence-bundle-and-br-kg-atlas-card}\label{app:b}

\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\textbf{Purpose}}{Purpose}}\label{b-purpose}

\hyperref[app:b]{Appendix B} should record the evidence substrate available to Brain Researcher during planning and review. It links the episode query to resolved entities, ONVOC normalization, graph paths, evidence tiers, source/\allowbreak{}provenance coverage, connector failures, and release-readiness caveats.
